subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw support a synchronous result-return contract for `POST /hooks/agent`, and if so should the supported shape be `waitForResult`/`announceToMain`, a dedicated sync endpoint, or a result-reference fetch flow?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public Gateway HTTP behavior and security-sensitive hook output semantics that automation cannot choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt linked PR shape with hardening
options.body: Proceed with `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` if maintainers also define output limits, error disclosure, retry, timeout, and audit behavior before merge.

options.title: Choose a narrower contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the PR around a dedicated sync endpoint or short-lived result reference if that better fits the Gateway security boundary.

options.title: Decline core sync hooks
options.body: Keep the async `/hooks/agent` plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers do not want this surface in core.

recommendation.title: Adopt linked PR shape with hardening
recommendation.body: Proceed with `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` if maintainers also define output limits, error disclosure, retry, timeout, and audit behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public Gateway API shape, docs, and security posture rather than a narrow code defect.
